paths.title: Ancestral Weapon
paths.description: Draw the enemy's attention with the strength of the ancestors behind you, marking foes and making your exchanges with them increasingly punishing. Charisma deepens your healing reserves, and a successful action point attack lets you spend a healing surge to stay in the fight. As your bond grows, Rampage can carry an at-will technique into the opening, while your greatest rage adds force to every blow against an enemy you have marked.

paths.title: Bear Warrior
paths.description: Take on a bear's shape when you rage, gaining tougher protection and the freedom to catch your breath with second wind without slowing your assault. Action points offer further healing, while mauling blows knock enemies down and threaten another strike when they stand beside you. Your growing strength sends foes flying on a raging critical hit, and your fiercest rage carries you between opponents before settling into steady regeneration and resistance to being moved.

paths.title: Nocturnal
paths.description: Hunt through the boundary between the world and its shadows, passing through obstacles as you charge a visible enemy. An action point spent on a successful at-will attack can send you straight into another charge, while a brutal follow-up blow grants temporary vitality. Shadow packmates flank enemies alongside your companions, and your later gifts let you spend a healing surge to move through solid barriers or leave lingering necrotic and poisonous wounds with every melee hit.

paths.title: Winter Fury
paths.description: Freeze enemies in place and make their helpless footing count, striking immobilized foes with greater accuracy and force. Your action point attacks can lock down a cluster of enemies, while a mantle of glacial armor absorbs punishment until repeated blows or fire break it apart. With experience, you resist the cold and can turn ordinary damage into frost, and your greatest rage lets each at-will hit hold its victim in place for another assault.

paths.title: Stonefire Rager
paths.description: Endure with the patience of stone, then erupt in a rush of heat and violence. You can turn some critical hits against you into ordinary wounds, and an action point attack adds Constitution-driven fire damage while knocking its victims down. Remaining outside a rage lets you shelter behind broad damage resistance, while being bloodied brings fire resistance and harder blows. When you finally unleash your volcanic rage, nearby enemies burn each turn and those that strike you leave themselves open to your answer.

paths.title: Calm Fury
paths.description: Focus your anger into deliberate Rage Strikes, using them even before you enter a rage and eventually putting greater force behind each blow. Spending an action point restores health, and a precise strike against Reflex lets you draw on a healing surge. A critical hit can turn Rampage into another use of that healing attack, while your greatest rage steadies the accuracy of at-will attacks and Rage Strikes and rewards their hits with temporary vitality.
